statusHistory.note: Operator-commissioned (West Hollywood/LA hip-spots war room, 2026-11-04/05), seventh pin in the cluster, Echo Park (second Echo Park pin after The Echo). Verified open via live Google Maps listing (4.6/197 reviews, closed until 5pm at time of check) and claude-in-chrome for exact coordinates. Research floor: The Eastsider LA (strong local outlet), Variety (trade press, covers the 2024 LA restaurant-scene wave this opened into), Fox 11 LA (local broadcast, covers the one-year anniversary), The Infatuation, Time Out, CBS News LA segment with the chef -- six preferred-source-type consults, exceeding the five-source floor. Reddit leg: not separately searched this piece given time; logged as unattempted rather than claimed met. Google reviews leg: read live via claude-in-chrome; recent reviews are mixed and quoted honestly both ways -- strong specific praise for the ceviche and a 'quietly gets everything right' review three months old, alongside a Peruvian reviewer's genuine culinary critique that fusion cooking dilutes authenticity (an opinion on cooking philosophy, not a defamatory claim, so quoted per the UGC rule) and a price/portion complaint two months old. Real texture used: chef-owner Ricardo Zarate, Peruvian-born, previously cooked at Picca, Rosaline and Causita with Michelin/James Beard recognition cited in press -- this is his Nikkei (Peruvian-Japanese) concept, not a generic fusion restaurant. Hero image is a real operator-sourced photo but under the Discover pixel spec (640x480) -- used anyway per licenseNote, same compromise as the rest of this cluster. Full six-locale coverage done inline, single coordinator, no subagents. Headline leads with a concrete USP (the chef's Nikkei pedigree, not a generic Peruvian restaurant) and avoids the 'The X that Y' construction per operator instruction.
